narrative.overview: APCS RAIL 將 2025 APCS Python 0915 範例與原創模擬題轉化為午夜深藍琺瑯底板（#0B1230）上的互動捷運路網圖與調度時刻表，大幅減少冗長敘述文字，讓 45°/90° 路線軌跡、可點擊車站與程式碼執行窗口成為核心焦點。
keyCharacteristics: 45° 與 90° 幾何五色路線（L1–L5）交會於 CENTRAL 轉乘點。
1px 瓷白細線時刻表框架搭配深藍內凹程式碼井（#070C22），零誇張浮動陰影。
桌面左側垂直軌道導覽＋手機固定底部 4 鍵分頁列，教師端改採頂部號誌綠水平調度分頁。

rules.name: Line Geometry Discipline
rules.body: All transit segments in SVG network diagrams bend strictly at 45-degree and 90-degree angles with clear separation around the CENTRAL hub.

rules.name: Minimal Copy Discipline
rules.body: Headers and panels omit intro paragraphs and kickers above headings, prioritizing interactive controls, tabular figures, and concise code.

dos: Do keep every rail segment aligned at 45° or 90° angles with clear CENTRAL interchange spacing.
Do maintain 1px porcelain hairlines and dark #0B1230 foreground ink on Amber (#FFC20E), Cyan (#14B8C4), and Porcelain (#FFFFFF) pills.
donts: Don't place eyebrows above headings or multi-line prose paragraphs in header banners.
Don't use >1px colored border-left/right stripes or reintroduce light SaaS card grids.
